title: Moisturizer for Dull Skin: How to Choose One for Indian Weather
ex: Why dull skin is usually thirsty, rough and uneven-looking, which moisturiser ingredients help, day vs night picks, and choices by skin type and season.
rt: Moisturizer for Dull Skin: How to Choose One | Mirc Glow
rd: How to pick a moisturizer for dull skin in India: humectants, niacinamide, aloe and plant oils, day vs night choices, and tips by skin type and weather.
quick: Dull skin is usually dehydrated, a bit rough and uneven-looking. Pick a moisturiser with a humectant such as hyaluronic acid or aloe vera, some oil to seal it in, and ideally niacinamide. Use a lighter one by day under sunscreen and a richer cream at night.
facts: Most dullness comes from dehydration, rough texture and sun, not skin colour.
Humectants like hyaluronic acid and glycerin pull water into the top layer of skin.
Vitamin C is usually worn in the morning under sunscreen.
A more even look takes around 8 to 12 weeks of steady use.
